title: rookita marih qawwalayla
intro: Atu kaxxa baxsi gibbatteh tan roocit garaytam faxxa, intiita kaak ximo af taaxigeh immay sorkocô baxi qaago kak weeh yan. Duquurinnaay, maxhaxaa kee ellecaboh agle aydaadul, ta massakaxxale Yallih taama abeyna kulli waktih sabrih asta yekke. iyyaay liggiditteh qeltut tan biyak coolaytem, ​​dubuk mablaa kee rufto inki uddurut tadaarem?
clues: Anu kaxxa kasaara foocal migaq kaak sabri asta yekke nabiyyi kinniyo.
Anu mango lab urru luk barkat geeh, takkay immay tiya gersi marih aysinu yok beenih.
Yi kacni woo baye numuh kaxxam gibduk sugeeh, intiita yok rookah qaduk temeete, uxih Yalla akke waytek inkinnah malkitta.
Anu inni baxa ruubeh wadirih gorrisuh anu baye tiya kee kay toobokoyta, ken kassiiseh niya argiqe waytaama.
meqe xaagu quuka gufe wak, kamis foocal yok qideeh, garciik baad qagitak qaddooweh.
Anu Israa-eel xiqsitaah, yi taban kee namma baxak kaxxa agattiinah taban kee namma kedooda temeete.

arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَن جَآءَ ٱلْبَشِيرُ أَلْقَىٰهُ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦ فَٱرْتَدَّ بَصِيرًۭا ۖ قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verse: And when the bearer of good tidings arrived, he cast it over his face, and he returned [once again] seeing. He said, "Did I not tell you that I know from Allāh that which you do not know?" (12:96)
